description: Fetch email sending statistics (delivered, opens, clicks, bounces, etc.) for a date range. Example: get_stats({ start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "SG.xxx" })

end_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

name: get_stats
